integrity: The present repaired mathematical statement has an explicit transfer proof and bounded independent microscopic corroboration; prior total-cycle formulas are credited rather than claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only all-vertex-flipping configurations, their exact twist response, and their rarity relative to the known total two-cycle population are newly asserted. Fixed-point and complete two-cycle census, modulo-six total-cycle sign law, standard cyclic-word transfer counts and general period-two theorem are prior work. Historical priority search is best-of-knowledge, not exhaustive.
title: Fully flipping majority two-cycles on cubic prisms and Möbius ladders
